plugins.name: spring-tools
plugins.description: Spring Tools Language Server — real-time diagnostics, completions, and code navigation for Spring Boot projects. Operates standalone without requiring JDT Language Server. On first run, downloads the language server JAR (checksum-verified) from cdn.spring.io and launches it as a local Java process; requires Java 21+ on PATH.

skills.name: create-spring-boot-project
skills.description: Creates a new Spring Boot project by downloading it from start.spring.io using curl, then extracting it into the target directory. Use this when a user asks to create, generate, initialize, or scaffold a new Spring Boot project.
headings: Step 1: Detect the available JDK version
Step 4: Download and extract the project
Step 6: Switch the working directory into the new project
Step 7: Report back to the user
skills.name_hint: 创建 · spring · boot · 项目

skills.name: quickfix
skills.description: Retrieves the explanation and fix instructions for a specific Spring Boot diagnostic error code and applies the fix to a specific file. Use this when you encounter a Spring Boot warning or error and need to know how to fix it.

skills.name: validate
skills.description: MUST be used whenever a user or agent asks to find problems, check for issues, or validate changes in a Spring Boot project. Uses the spring-tools MCP server to check for validation problems in the project's source files.

commands.name: refresh
commands.description: Refresh the Spring Tools workspace so the language server re-indexes files on disk (use after /rewind, git checkout, external edits, etc.).
